recommendations.confidence_explanation: Directly observed from the IAM policy's parsed statement.
recommendations.impact: Overly broad IAM grants expand the blast radius if the associated role's credentials are compromised, and make least-privilege review difficult.
recommendations.suggested_change: Scope the action list to the specific API calls required, and constrain Resource to the specific ARNs the role needs instead of *.
recommendations.summary: A Terraform-managed IAM policy statement allows a wildcard action (e.g. service:*) with Resource set to *.
recommendations.title: IAM policy grants a wildcard action on all resources
recommendations.trade_offs: Narrowing permissions may require iterating as new resource types are added, and risks under-provisioning if scoped too tightly.

recommendations.confidence_explanation: Directly observed from the trivy-action step's `with:` keys.
recommendations.impact: Unpatchable-but-known vulnerabilities can reach a published image undetected.
recommendations.suggested_change: Remove ignore-unfixed, or pair it with a documented, time-boxed exception process.
recommendations.summary: The Trivy scan step sets ignore-unfixed, so Critical/High findings without an available fix do not block the pipeline.
recommendations.title: Trivy CI gate ignores unfixed vulnerabilities
recommendations.trade_offs: May block builds on vulnerabilities with no vendor fix yet available.
